crossRefs.note: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
Grace be with you all. Amen.
So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than…
If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!
Jesus said to him, “ ‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.
In all things be showing yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, be showing integrity, seriousness…
Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory…
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…
